correctness.rationale: Literal endpoint path-segment reversal formulas give involutions P_j,S_j. Balanced conjugates yield independent pure adjacent transpositions of X and Y; odd-size combined P3 and S3 moves plus cancellable pure Y swaps yield every X adjacent transposition. The explicit sorting procedure and ≤3/≤12 macro lengths prove connectivity and quadratic bounds, with orientation quotient for K2,3 and n1. Independent direct backbite adjacency enumeration and constructive macro checks reproduce the identities; finite tests are corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: Complete bipartite graphs with Hamiltonian paths form a natural exactly characterized graph family. The balanced case sits at the sharp half-degree boundary of an explicit new conjecture; the entire one-extra-vertex class is additionally covered. Pure adjacent-permutation generators give a uniform constructive algorithm and quadratic moves instead of only existential connectedness, making this a meaningful full-family advance.
